question: By what power and up to what limit does the yoginī named Will operate with the siddhas?
premises: A yoginī named Icchā is identified
She is associated with the siddhas
Her operation extends up to māyā by supreme will
inference: The yoginī Icchā, with the siddhas, operates up to the limit of māyā by supreme will.
uncertainties: The verbal action governing māyāntaṃ is implicit in this verse.
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, together with the siddhas, extends up to māyā by the supreme will.
